name: Unival! Paranormal Girls Strike!!
original_name: ゆにばる！ PARANORMAL GIRLS STRIKE!!
source:
Shinichirou is the master of the ‘Big World House’, but the tenants aren’t human. They’re witches, gods and aliens! They have lots of enemies so every day is troublesome and he has to help fight them off to protect their ‘peaceful’ life.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
新一郎是"大世界庄"的管理员，可住户们都不是人类，而是魔女、神明和外星人！她们树敌众多，每天都会惹来麻烦。为了守护众人"和平"的生活，新一郎不得不协助击退那些敌人。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
